column1: TrenCart Customer API — Reference for App Developer
All responses are JSON with the envelope: {"success": true|false, "message": "...", "data": ... }
Auth: after login/registration you receive a "token". Send it on every authenticated request as header:  Authorization: Bearer <token>
A request with a missing/invalid/expired token on a login-required endpoint returns HTTP 401 with {"success":false,"message":"..."}
All endpoints below are relative to the Base URL, e.g. "customer/products.php" = https://trencart.com/api/customer/products.php
